subject: skill:frame
gist: Frame asks what is open and credits the owner only with answers
reason: The frame's written depth puts every open behaviour to the owner through the interview, and its inline line credits the owner only with the owner's choices and names each floor, since QA runs found frames settling these alone.

authorisedBy.words: The operator's card of 2026-10-15 on the QA series, "One fix job after the fifth family", and the card of that day, "Words at the list edit the entry; at a ticket's open they override", with the delegation of 2026-10-16 whose words finalise the fix job's slices: a request that names a mode is taken as chosen and goes on with no yes awaited, a question asked only for a choice it leaves open; the record names every floor found and, where the owner names a mode below one, says so with choice owner and the floor's reason; a mode named at the ticket list edits the entry and one named at a ticket's open overrides it; the builder reads the reviewer's brief at the inline depth only; and at the written frame depth every open behaviour goes to the owner through the interview, an inline frame line crediting the owner only with the owner's answers
